original.host_boundary: Complete original get/set_gapcolor, is_dashed and inverse helper, original Line.draw with only rasterization decorator excluded, actual color validation/conversion and complete GC.set_dashes. Numeric transformed Path storage, no-marker/no-effects and other presentation GC/renderer methods are explicit capability hosts. Stage wrappers call original helpers unchanged and observe successful draw_path prefixes; they do not supply a substitute branch or validation algorithm. Live rc cycle uses accepted stored-rc/by_key host, not an Axes property iterator or full Cycler. Leaf draw dataLim stays null because setup omits add_line/update_line_limits. Native mutable RGB storage is source-only; no public API is frozen here.

typed_boundaries.carrier: Only String?/None gap setter. The last two native mutable RGB storage/mutation observations remain complete source-only evidence.
typed_boundaries.stages: Complete original helper/GC/presentation stage traces and successful prefixes stay intact. The typed tests invoke the real checked backend, never resolve foreground early to simulate painting. Error cases assert exact stage error and stale; private backend integration tests additionally observe the writer prefix because no public partial-SVG return API exists.
typed_boundaries.paint: Successful complete backend draws compare polyline order/count and original RGBA/dash/offset meaning using the existing CSS serializer convenience profile. After the actual draw, completed native RGBA stages receive independent bit-exact raw-helper checks; foreground is never resolved early. This does not claim native SVG float text, caps/joins, marker or pixel-overlap compatibility.
typed_boundaries.origin: Line captured scaled_dashes_as_list records the last scaling operation. Empty inverse errors are exact list/tuple IndexErrors; current rc cannot infer this history. Native list/tuple identity/layout is not exposed by the typed Array carrier.
typed_boundaries.rc: Real original rc validators and color helpers generate all results. Live cycle by_key storage is the accepted narrow host, not general Cycler mutation or an Axes color iterator.
typed_boundaries.setup: Typed plot_line supplies attachment. One explicit null dataLim/request input bridge matches the original leaf host that omitted add_line/update_line_limits; fixed manual parent limits and Null ticks isolate parent draw phases. Setter mark_drawn is only the recorded stale=False input.
typed_boundaries.alpha: Original alpha override is replacement, not multiplication; Some none is not None and alpha0 is not visibility. Raw optional gap/alpha survive all paints unchanged.
typed_boundaries.float: Finite values, signed zero and infinities compare by bits; NaN by classification. Native NaN payload and private global RGBA cache identity are evidence, not a portable contract.
